Une base prête à personnaliser, de l’aut: A foundation ready to customize, from authentication to access management.
Inscription et connexion JWT, confirmati: Registration and JWT sign-in, configurable email verification, password recovery and changes: account flows are already connected to the API.
Informations personnelles, photo de prof: Personal details, profile photos and last sign-in. Modal forms, French/English translations and light/dark themes provide a consistent interface foundation.
Initialisez un super administrateur, gér: Initialize a super administrator, manage roles and assign permissions. FastAPI dependencies enforce access checks; the interface supports descriptions and reversible disabling.
Pagination, recherche et tri partagent l: Pagination, search and sorting share conventions across the frontend and API. Redis caching, invalidation and rate limiting can be attached to the routes that need them.
Delegate long-running work to Celery. RabbitMQ persists messages, while task utilities provide retry handling and status lookup.
Configurations Docker de développement e: Development and production Docker configurations, Alembic migrations, CI tests, metrics, logs and dashboards: tools to evolve and observe your project are included.
Pages, composants réutilisables et rendu: Pages, reusable components and rendering suited to your application flows.
Validation des entrées, documentation de: Input validation, route documentation and TypeScript client generation.
Modèles SQL et migrations versionnées po: SQL models and versioned migrations to support schema changes.
Réponses mises en cache, invalidation pa: Cached responses, grouped invalidation and configurable request limits.
Un worker dédié et des messages persista: A dedicated worker and persistent messages for background processing.
Photos de profil conservées localement p: Profile photos stored locally by default, or in S3-compatible storage.
Confirmation d’adresse et récupération d: Email verification and account recovery with reusable email templates.
Dashboards provisionnés, collecte des lo: Provisioned dashboards, log collection, Blackbox probes and alert rules.
Un serveur Socket.IO intégré au backend: A Socket.IO server integrated into the backend for your application events.
Le client généré reste côté serveur Next: The generated client stays on the Next.js server. Browser services use an explicit proxy, while TanStack Query hooks manage data, caching and targeted mutations.
Réutilisez les contrôles de rôles et de: Reuse role and permission checks on new routes. Access is read from the database, so disabling it does not require recreating sessions.
Appliquez les conventions de pagination: Apply pagination conventions and cache utilities to your domain resources, then keep matching parameters and types in frontend services.
Déclarez une tâche, ajoutez son module a: Declare a task, register its module with the worker, then enqueue it from a route. Reuse dispatch and tracking utilities instead of coupling routes directly to Celery.

Créez vos modèles et migrations, exposez: Create models and migrations, expose FastAPI routes, then regenerate the TypeScript client to connect services and components.
Les pull requests exécutent les contrôle: Pull requests run quality checks. Use production configuration and dashboards to prepare deployment and monitor service behavior.
Concentrez-vous sur votre logique métier: Focus on your domain logic. This template brings account flows, access control, data and operational tools together in a foundation designed for reuse.
